cases.sentence: Все это произошло потому, что израильтяне согрешили против Господа, своего Бога, Который вывел их из Египта, из-под власти фараона, ___.
cases.explain: «египетского царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

cases.sentence: Они поклонялись ___ 8 и следовали обычаям народов, которых Господь прогнал от них, а также обычаям, которые ввели цари Израиля.
cases.explain: «другим богам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

cases.sentence: Везде они строили себе святилища на возвышенностях во всех городах, от ___ до укрепленного города.
cases.explain: «сторожевой башни» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

cases.sentence: Они ставили ___ и столбы Ашеры на каждом высоком холме и под каждым тенистым деревом.
cases.explain: «священные камни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill, and under every green tree;

cases.sentence: Они ставили священные камни и столбы Ашеры на каждом ___ и под каждым тенистым деревом.
cases.explain: «высоком холме» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill, and under every green tree;

cases.sentence: Они ставили священные камни и столбы Ашеры на каждом высоком холме и под каждым ___.
cases.explain: «тенистым деревом» — after the preposition «под», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill, and under every green tree;

cases.sentence: Господь предостерегал Израиль и Иудею через пророков и провидцев: «Сверните со ___!
cases.explain: «злых путей» — after the preposition «со», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel, and to Judah, by every prophet, and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

cases.sentence: Они гадали и ворожили, и предавались ___ в глазах Господа, вызывая Его гнев.
cases.explain: «злым делам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

cases.sentence: Иеровоам увел Израиль от Господа и склонил его к ___.
cases.explain: «страшному греху» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following Yahweh, and made them sin a great sin.

cases.sentence: Они поклонялись и Господу, и назначили людей ___ священниками в святилищах на возвышенностях, которые приносили там для них жертвы.
cases.explain: «разного рода» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So they feared Yahweh, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

cases.explain: «прежние обычаи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

cases.sentence: Господь, Который вывел вас из Египта ___ и простертой рукой, — вот Тот, Кого вы должны почитать.
cases.explain: «великой силой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: but you shall fear Yahweh, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.

cases.sentence: Но они не слушали и хранили ___.
cases.explain: «прежние обычаи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.

cases.sentence: До ___ их дети и внуки продолжают делать то же, что делали их отцы.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.
